note: Chapter 1 carries both goals: goal 1 is keyed from 'wins the ball' (the steal from Boban) through 'one-two' to 'and scores'; the film cuts to goal 2 just before 'Then he steals', and the ball hits the net on 'goal' — keep the pause at '...'. Chapter 2 is the slow replay of the left-foot curler; chapter 3 the kneeling 'thinker' celebration; chapter 4 the lesson.

chapters.label: Two goals, live
chapters.text: France v Croatia, 1998. Croatia score first! Straight away, right-back Lilian Thuram wins the ball, plays a one-two with Djorkaeff, and scores! Then he steals it again and curls it in... goal!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. He wins the ball back, then curls it with his left foot, round the keeper, into the far corner.

chapters.label: The thinker
chapters.text: His only two goals for France! He kneels, finger on chin, like a thinker.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: defenders can win the ball high and join the attack. If the other team scores, reply straight away!
